documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Alivus Life Sciences reported a healthy Q2 FY27 performance with revenue up 16% year-on-year to INR682 crores, driven by strong growth in the non-GPL and CDMO businesses alongside improved profitability. Management reiterated its full-year FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% and EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range. The Solapur facility's Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27, supporting future growth and backward integration. Additionally, the company remains net debt-free with strong cash and cash equivalents of INR1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026. Alivus Life Sciences reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹6,820 million, representing a 16.0% YoY growth supported by healthy demand across key global markets and CDMO traction.

guidance.claim: Management reiterated its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.
guidance.quote: So accordingly, we reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.

guidance.claim: Management is confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expressed confidence in sustaining momentum and delivering consistent growth due to ongoing capacity expansion and a healthy development pipeline.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, our ongoing capacity expansion and healthy development pipeline give us confidence in sustaining this momentum and delivering consistent growth.

guidance.claim: Management is guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards the second half.
guidance.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

guidance.claim: The company expects to sustain EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

guidance.claim: Management expects growth in the GPL business to remain flattish in FY '27.
guidance.quote: While growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY '27, the business has been historically weighted towards the second half of the year and we expect a similar trend to play out this year, resulting in a stronger H2 performance.

guidance.claim: The company expects its R&D expenditure to reach a steady state of around 4% of revenues.
guidance.quote: So we should sort of end up at a steady state of around 4%.

demand_outlook.claim: The non-GPL business grew 20.8% year-on-year and contributes 79% of overall revenues.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business grew 20.8% year-on-year and now contributes 79% of our overall revenues.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue from operations for the quarter stood at INR682 crores, up 16% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: During quarter 2, revenue from operations stood at INR682 crores, up 16% year-on-year, driven by new product launches and a healthy demand across our existing portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: GPL revenues recorded a marginal growth of 1% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: GPL revenues recorded a marginal growth of 1% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: The generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2.
demand_outlook.quote: Our generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2, supported by healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 16.0% YoY supported by healthy demand across all key markets and recent product launches.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2FY27 was another strong quarter for us, with revenue growing 16.0% YoY, supported by healthy demand across all key markets and robust contributions from recent launches.

demand_outlook.claim: The non-GPL business grew 26.5% year-on-year in Q1 FY '27 due to new product launches and sustained demand across all markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year, driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: GPL business revenue declined by 52.6% year-on-year in Q1 FY '27 due to inventory rationalization.
demand_outlook.quote: GPL has been muted as a result of inventory rationalization. And so if you recall, Q4 was pretty strong, and we saw a dip in Q1, a decline of 52.6% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: The CDMO segment achieved 3.8% year-on-year growth during the first quarter of FY '27.
demand_outlook.quote: Our CDMO business recorded 3.8% Y-o-Y growth during the first quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the CDMO business to gain momentum in H2 FY '27 due to newly added projects.
demand_outlook.quote: However, we can expect the segment to gain momentum in the second half of the year, supported by contributions from newly added projects.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Solapur facility is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to our expansion plans, the Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the R&D center at Taloja is progressing well and expected on schedule early next year.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of our R&D center at Taloja is also progressing well, and we hope to be on schedule early next year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the quarter was INR105 crores and for the first half, it was INR190 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow movement, capex for the quarter was INR105 crores and for the first half, it was INR190 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the new R&D facility at Taloja in Navi Mumbai is advancing as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The construction of new R&D facility at Taloja (Navi Mumbai) is advancing as planned

capex_expansion.claim: The Solapur facility experienced a slight delay and is scheduled to become operational in early Q3 FY '27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capex front, Solapur continues to progress as planned. There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the new R&D center at Taloja has started and is progressing on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction at Taloja, the R&D center has begun in earnest, and it will happen on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex incurred in Q1 FY '27 was INR85 crores, with total FY '27 capex expected to be around INR540 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow moment, our capex for the quarter stood at INR85 crores. We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity expansion will add 160KL at Dahej and 110KL at Ankleshwar.
capex_expansion.quote: So Dahej is getting 160KL and Ankleshwar is getting like 110KL.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter were at 41.8%, up 520 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 880 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter were at 41.8%, up 520 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 880 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Excluding the onetime income, adjusted EBITDA margin was approximately 39.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Excluding the onetime income, adjusted EBITDA margin was approximately 39.5%, reflecting improved operating efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for the quarter stood at INR197 crores with PAT margins at 28.9%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT for the quarter stood at INR197 crores with PAT margins at 28.9%, up 390 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 680 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins for H1 stood at 62.3%, up 590 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margins for H1 stood at 62.3%, up 590 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY to 64.4% driven by a favorable product mix.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin at 64.4%, was up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY, on the back of a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin reached 28.9%, expanding 390 bps QoQ and 680 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: PAT Margin at 28.9%, was up 390 bps QoQ & 680 bps YoY.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins expanded by 510 basis points year-on-year to 60.2% in Q1 FY '27 due to a favorable product mix and new launches.
margins_costs.quote: On the profitability front, a favourable product mix and newer launches helped improve gross margins to 60.2%, an increase in 510 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for Q1 FY '27 increased by 650 basis points year-on-year to 36.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced operational efficiencies and forex gains also supported 650 basis points Y-o-Y improvement in EBITDA margins to 36.6%.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices have been rising, beginning with solvents and moving to key starting materials.
margins_costs.quote: While we are seeing the raw material prices are going up. And in fact, it started from solvents and then now to KSM.

orders_capacity.claim: The pipeline remains robust with over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as on September 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our pipeline remains robust with over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as on September 30, 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The high potent API portfolio has 30 new products in the active grid representing a total addressable market of $86 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high potent API portfolio continues to advance with 30 new products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $86 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: Non-GPL business generated 79% of overall revenue in Q2 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Non-GPL business now contributes 79% of our overall revenues.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has accumulated 630 DMF and CEP filings across major global markets.
orders_capacity.quote: Filed 630 DMFs and CEPs across major markets; United States, Europe, Japan, Russia, Brazil, South Korea, Taiwan, Canada, China and Australia

orders_capacity.claim: The high-potent API portfolio comprises 29 active products representing an addressable market of $82 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high-potent API portfolio continues to advance with 29 products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $82 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: The company held 617 global DMF and CEP filings as of June 30.
orders_capacity.quote: The pipeline remains robust, with 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as on June 30.

capital_allocation.claim: The company remains a net debt-free company with strong free cash flow and cash equivalents.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a net debt-free company, and we have generated a strong free cash flow of INR270 crores leading to cash and cash equivalents, including short-term investments of INR1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Return on Invested Capital Employed expanded to ~34%, reflecting strong asset productivity.
capital_allocation.quote: ROICE expanded to ~34% – underscoring strong asset productivity and disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: Fixed asset turnover ratio stood at 2.1 times despite ongoing capital expenditure.
capital_allocation.quote: FATR is 2.1 times – Asset turns remained above 2x despite the impact of the ongoing capex cycle.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains its debt-free balance sheet status.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a debt-free company.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash flow generated during Q1 FY '27 was INR90 crores, leading to total cash and cash equivalents of INR880 crores as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated a strong free cash flow of INR90 crores, leading to cash and cash equivalents including short-term investments of INR880 crores as of 30th June 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management remains mindful of the evolving external environment as the second half of FY27 begins.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we move into the second half of FY27, we remain mindful of the evolving external environment.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing geopolitical tensions and war conditions are creating raw material price uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: The issue is this war situation, and what it's doing to raw material prices. So we need to be a little bit cautious.

risks_headwinds.claim: Construction at Solapur experienced delays due to labor availability issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: Part of it was also -- there's been a slowdown with labor and a few other things. But Ankleshwar, Dahej will complete on time.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 of the Solapur facility is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Coming to our expansion plans, the Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company reiterates its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.
management_commitments.quote: So accordingly, we reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.

management_commitments.claim: Management is confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to double the CDMO business in the next 3 to 4 years.
management_commitments.quote: Except the fact that on CDMO, we have been guiding that we will double the business from where it is today in next 3 to 4 years' time, which would effectively contribute to about between 12% to 15% of the overall revenues is how we are looking at the CDMO business.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans a brownfield capacity addition of ~160KL at the Dahej API facility.
Management targets revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27.
management_commitments.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range for FY '27.
management_commitments.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

management_commitments.claim: The Solapur facility will become operational in early Q3 FY '27.
management_commitments.quote: There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to spend approximately INR540 crores on capex in FY '27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.
